summary: bytesWritten reports bytes passed into the compression engine before processing.

target.notes: Preserve Node Buffer/options/error semantics; platform compression libraries are usable only behind this compatibility contract.

semantics.meaning: input bytes written to engine, not compressed output size

tests.name: normal
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createGzip(); s.end('abc'); s.on('end',()=>console.log(s.bytesWritten>=3)); s.resume();
